title: Indian startup Sarvam, which is pursuing sovereign AI, is facing online backlash for offering Chinese open-weight models on its Token Factory inference service (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
summary: Saritha Rai / Bloomberg: Indian startup Sarvam, which is pursuing sovereign AI, is facing online backlash for offering Chinese open-weight models on its Token Factory inference service — Indian startup Sarvam has begun selling access to DeepSeek and other Chinese AI models, triggering an online backlash over its role …
